## Change

Describe the behavior or contract changed and why.

## Evidence

- [ ] Full test suite passes.
- [ ] Relevant benchmark/reference artifacts were regenerated or explicitly not affected.
- [ ] Failure modes and backward-compatibility impact are documented.
- [ ] No secret, token, private key, runtime DB, personal data, or customer record is included.
- [ ] New side-effecting tools define scope, closed schema, idempotency, reconcile, budget, approval, compensation, and postcondition.
- [ ] New external claims are still PENDING unless the fail-closed claim register binds all required hashed evidence.

## Reproduction

Provide exact non-secret commands and environment requirements.
